from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

def analyze_frame(frame_num, x_cam, y_cam, heading):
    img = Image.open(f"/work/observations/obs_{frame_num:04d}.png")
    arr = np.array(img)
    print(f"=== Frame {frame_num} (pos=({x_cam:.2f}, {y_cam:.2f}), heading={heading}) ===")
    
    # Unique colors or segments
    # Find brown chair / table:
    # Brown: R in [80, 160], G in [40, 100], B in [10, 60]
    is_brown = (arr[:,:,0] > 70) & (arr[:,:,0] < 170) & (arr[:,:,1] > 30) & (arr[:,:,1] < 110) & (arr[:,:,2] < 60)
    # Green plant: R < 60, G > 90, B < 60
    is_green = (arr[:,:,0] < 80) & (arr[:,:,1] > 90) & (arr[:,:,2] < 80)
    # Pot (terracotta): R > 150, G in [60, 110], B in [30, 80]
    is_pot = (arr[:,:,0] > 140) & (arr[:,:,1] > 50) & (arr[:,:,1] < 120) & (arr[:,:,2] > 20) & (arr[:,:,2] < 90)
    # Couch (dark slate/gray): R in [70, 120], G in [75, 125], B in [85, 135]
    is_couch = (arr[:,:,2] > arr[:,:,0] + 5) & (arr[:,:,0] > 50) & (arr[:,:,0] < 120)
    # White cabinet: R > 200, G > 200, B > 200 (not wall/ceiling)
    # Floor is ~ [174, 166, 149], Wall is ~ [255, 255, 255] or [245, 245, 240], Ceiling is dark [35, 40, 50]
    
    for name, mask in [("brown", is_brown), ("green", is_green), ("pot", is_pot), ("couch", is_couch)]:
        ys, xs = np.where(mask)
        if len(ys) > 0:
            print(f"  {name}: {len(ys)} px, u in [{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], v in [{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}], bottom v={ys.max()}")

analyze_frame(1, 0, 0, 0)
analyze_frame(8, 0, 0, 315)
analyze_frame(12, 0, 1.5, 0)
analyze_frame(14, 0, 1.5, 90)
analyze_frame(19, -0.707, 2.207, 270)
analyze_frame(20, -0.707, 2.207, 0)
'
